Original chat archive

120 answers · Recorded interface labels

Established-minus-recent gaps: 25, 10 and 30 percentage points. Holm-adjusted p = 0.0938, 0.2500 and 0.0938: none below 0.05. Model backend identities and all interface settings were not independently verified.

Supplementary local experiment

120 outputs · 8 November 2026

Keyword search returns passages; Qwen baseline generates without documents; Qwen + BM25 generates with retrieved passages. These are separate experimental conditions, not a controlled six-model leaderboard.

Method and interpretation

What counts as correct?

Fully correct means 3/3 checkpoints and no material additional factual error. Partial means some required facts are correct, or all three are correct but an added claim is wrong. Incorrect means zero checkpoints. All errors are retained. Ratings are AI-assisted; independent human agreement was not measured.

Question bank

Twenty established concepts were documented before 2020. The twenty selected recent features first appeared in 2025. Five ecosystems each contribute four questions per group. Pairing matches task and ecosystem, not independently validated difficulty.

Local experiment

Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct, MLX 4-bit; seed 17, temperature 0, maximum 192 generated tokens. RAG uses BM25 (k1 = 1.5, b = 0.75), top 3 of 1552 frozen documentation chunks from 56 source URLs. Keyword search uses token overlap. The corpus was selected around an already-known bank.

What the results show

The original conditions favor established questions descriptively. Adjusted tests do not establish significance. Retrieval helped some answers and failed on others. Saved-data reproduction audits calculations; it does not create new model responses or prove rating agreement.
